evals.name: branded-word-refine
evals.description: Refine a weak company board Word document using the company's brand tokens
evals.input: Polish this weak company board Word doc; use the company's brand colors (e.g. red/gray), fix hierarchy and tables
evals.expected_behavior: DOCX with 12pt body, company tokens applied (no stray blue in headings/tables/links/diagrams), chapter page breaks, clean restrained tables, stable updated TOC; PDF exports from the DOCX and pdffonts shows embedded Japanese fonts

evals.name: cn-jp-split
evals.description: Produce separate Japanese and Chinese versions of one board material
evals.input: Produce separate Japanese and Chinese versions of this board material
evals.expected_behavior: Two files; no Japanese residue in the Chinese output and no Chinese residue in the Japanese output (proper nouns excepted); parallel section/table/figure numbering; language-specific fonts; each language proofread independently

evals.name: cfo-proposal-16x9
evals.description: Build a 16:9 CFO proposal deck from an outline
evals.input: Build a 16:9 CFO proposal deck from this outline
evals.expected_behavior: 1920x1080 HTML, html font-size 20px (1rem=20px), 6px brand accent bar, vertically filled (non-sparse) slides, company/topic visible in the first viewport; PDF page size is 16:9, all slides present, browser render matches PDF

evals.name: fund-flow-diagram
evals.description: Add a clean funds-flow diagram to a formal Word document page
evals.input: Add a funds-flow diagram to page 4
evals.expected_behavior: Clean left-to-right or top-to-bottom SVG/PNG with actor lanes, numbered steps, and a short note table; arrows land exactly on node edges; fewer than 9 nodes; only 1-2 brand-color focal nodes; inserted as a fixed image (no broken Word shape arrows); page has no overlapping objects

evals.name: numerical-fidelity-lock
evals.description: Preserve figures and language exactly through the render chain
evals.input: Rebuild this document that mixes yen figures and fiscal periods, with some data missing
evals.expected_behavior: All figures, units, currency symbols, and fiscal periods match the source exactly with no rounding or invention; missing data marked [DATA_GAP]; unverified legal/tax conclusions marked draft/assumption; output language consistent end to end (language lock)
